# sf-experimental

New skills that have not passed evals yet.

<!-- Generated by `sf build` from skills/ and market.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Install

```
/plugin install sf-experimental --marketplace yennanliu/skill-factory-1
```

or, once the marketplace is added (`/plugin marketplace add yennanliu/skill-factory-1`):

```
/plugin install sf-experimental@skill-factory
```

## Skills

| Skill | Version | Goal |
|---|---|---|
| `changelog-writer` | 0.1.0 | Turn a list of commits (git log output) into a release section in Keep a Changelog format, written for users of the project rather than its developers. |
| `commit-message-writer` | 0.1.0 | Write a git commit message for a diff, following Conventional Commits and the house rules, so history is greppable and changelogs can be generated from it. |
| `cron-explainer` | 0.1.0 | Explain a standard 5-field cron expression field by field and list its next run times from a given starting time, computed carefully rather than guessed. |
